issue.title: Return correct term statistics when a field is not found in a shard

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
If you ask for the term vectors of an artificial document with
term_statistics=true, but a shard does not have any terms of the doc's
field(s), it returns the doc's term vectors values as the shard-level
term statistics. This commit fixes that to return 0 for ttf and also
field-level aggregated statistics.

This closes #21906

body: @clintongormley I pushed a PR #21922 which fixes the term_statistics bug. I haven't yet addressed the NPE bug as I don't yet know what causes it. I think this should go under a separate commit though. Would appreciate your review and feedback on the changes.
